title: BusinessCaseType bounded Graph write edge S4b verification

always_on: Issue #694 acceptance criteria and offline-only boundary
scoped: BusinessCaseType S4b design and implementation plan
on_demand: S4 Graph read edge, S5 migration and S6a immutable evidence contracts
runtime: Synthetic fake-Graph fixtures only; no live connector

invariants: AC-S4B-01: Five operations and every execution canonically revalidate exact Graph REST v1.0 methods, targets, field allowlists, authorization, approval, S5 and request bindings, including workspace, site and both lists for every operation.
AC-S4B-02: Role, purpose, approval, target and separate write-identity drift blocks before transport.
AC-S4B-03: Creates use one bounded dedupe page, treat nextLink as ambiguity, resolve HTTP 409 by strict readback, and PATCH uses one freshly read exact ETag without retrying HTTP 412.
AC-S4B-04: Backfill writes only VorgangstypId and verifies the canonical S5 operation and idempotency hashes.

AC-S4B-05: Persistent intent generations are read back before write; failed marker acknowledgement remains open, and a physically closed generation is terminal across fresh hooks even when downstream closure confirmation fails.
AC-S4B-06: No live factory, credentials, network or tenant writes exist and BFF UAMI remains Sites.Selected/read.
AC-S4B-07: Contract, validator, all safety paths, compileall, DE/EN traceability and review evidence agree.
required_evidence: Canonical S4b domain and verification contracts
Exact operation target, field-allowlist and execute-time plan-revalidation assertions for all five operations
Synthetic paging, HTTP 409/412, strict actual-field readback and redacted transport-error traces
Persistent reconciliation acknowledgement and restart fail-closed traces
Fresh hook over shared persistent store blocks clear plus open intent after failed reconciliation acknowledgement
Fresh builder, hook and edge over a shared persistent store block replay after physical closure plus failed downstream confirmation
Case plans bind AufgabenFristen and task plans bind Akten so inactive-list drift blocks before transport
PATCH 5xx foreign response-item ID is ignored in favor of the exact mutation target
Standalone validator, focused unit tests and compileall
DE/EN spec and implementation plan with AC-S4B-01..07
Redacted offline CLI dry-run evidence for all five operations with zero live calls, credential reads and tenant writes
exit_conditions: All seven acceptance criteria are covered by executable checks.
All five operations match and revalidate their exact method, target, fields, authorization, approval and request contract.
Plan manipulation, cross-list target drift, paging, HTTP 409/412/5xx, strict readback, shared-store restart, terminal persistent closure and error-redaction paths pass.
No live factory, credential path, HTTP client or tenant write is introduced.
Protected PR review and required checks are green.
